summary: No invented content; all 15 conditions trace to the red box or the Weight row. The most consequential issue is 'BP < 90/60' split into independent SBP < 90 OR DBP < 60 disjuncts, which makes an isolated low diastolic (common on enalapril/carvedilol) Urgent; second, 'rapid worsening of symptoms' is encoded as a nested-qualified copy of the Heart failure trigger rather than a closer concept such as Decompensated cardiac failure. Unqualified 'Difficulty breathing' is literal to the page but will flag nearly every heart failure patient, so it deserves a clinician question.
